name: my-diserver
description: An organization server for diVoice and diMail, on Cloudflare Workers and D1.

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local && wrangler dev

cloudflare.label: diServer: organization server for diVoice and diMail

SERVER_SECRET.description: At least 32 random characters. It encrypts the keys your admins save and proves you own the server when you set up the organization from diMail or diVoice. Run `openssl rand -base64 36`, or use the one your app generated. **Keep a copy in your password manager.**

ORG_NAME.description: Your organization's name, shown on invite pages until an admin renames it in the app.

DB.description: The organization's database: members, invites, settings and encrypted keys. Never any email or dictated text.
